execution_status: Extracted from saved artifacts; training, retrieval, inference and calibration were not rerun for this documentation update.
source_code_review_note: This identifies the code inspected for documentation, not a verified run or training commit.

calibration.dataset: FEVER released development set; project-defined held-out test partition
calibration.brier_definition: Mean across claims of the sum of squared errors across the three class probabilities.

saved_prediction_id_check.scope: Read-only ID/count check of saved prediction files, not a full training-leakage audit or metric recomputation.

retrieval.dataset: FEVER released development set; project-defined held-out test partition
retrieval.strict_recall_definition: At least one complete gold evidence group must be contained in the first 25 retrieved sentence references.
retrieval.source_field: cutoffs entry where k == 25, field recall
retrieval.configuration_note: The folder retains original and rescored configurations. The rescored record identifies a dirty working tree; the saved metrics are not fully bound to a reproducible clean commit by these files.

publication_scope: Only aggregate metrics, selected configuration fields and SHA-256 hashes are included. Raw claims, predictions, datasets, indexes, model weights and machine-specific paths are excluded.
limitations: These are historical offline component measurements, not current end-to-end extension measurements.
The project test partition is not the official hidden FEVER test benchmark.
The results do not establish accuracy on political videos, recent news or arbitrary web claims.
Source hashes identify the saved files inspected; they do not independently reproduce or validate the experiments.
